claim: The local match reaches an actual first-to-three end screen.
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; enable edge assist; play both remaining sample rounds with keyboard input; assert winner and match score

claim: Race another course resets the score, timer, and round.
sandbox: complete /demo match; start another course; assert 0–0, round one, and 75 seconds

claim: The complete game is free and has no ads or checkout.
sandbox: complete the sample match and start a new course without an account, ad, payment, or blocked action

claim: A new match makes different deterministic course geometry.
where: landing audience, How to play, README
sandbox: generate one documented seed twice and a second documented seed once; assert repeat geometry is equal and the new course differs

claim: The race simulation advances one second in 60 fixed updates.
sandbox: start a deterministic race and assert sixty simulation updates reduce the active race clock by exactly one second

claim: A round ends at 75 seconds and awards the lead by distance, with a tie extension.
where: landing facts, How to play, README
sandbox: advance deterministic matches across the 75-second boundary with a leader and with an exact tie

claim: Jump, grapple, dash, and fall recovery affect the deterministic race state.
where: game controls, How to play, README
sandbox: apply each control to a running deterministic round and assert movement, grapple state, cooldown, and checkpoint recovery

claim: Mute, movement effects, and edge assist persist after reload.
sandbox: fresh /demo contexts in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; change all settings; reload; assert each saved state, repeating the WebKit check three times

claim: Mute stops the short game tones.
sandbox: two fresh /demo browser contexts with an AudioContext output probe; start one unmuted and one muted round; assert the unmuted start tone emits two oscillator starts and the muted round emits none

claim: Movement effects add screen shake and directional paper flecks during a dash, and the setting turns both off.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser with a Canvas output probe; dash with effects enabled and assert paper flecks plus changing horizontal course transforms, then disable the setting, dash again, and assert neither output occurs

claim: Edge assist jumps automatically near a platform edge.
sandbox: place matched deterministic players near the same platform edge with no jump input; assert edge assist launches one while the unassisted player stays grounded

claim: Both players can move at the same time from one keyboard.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; hold D and ArrowRight together; assert both course progress values increase

claim: The sample uses separate storage and reset does not change real saved data.
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: save a real setting; enter, change, and reset /demo; leave with Browser Back; verify real data is unchanged, demo keys are gone, Forward starts a clean sample, and a direct route change also clears demo keys

claim: The game sends no game or identity data to another origin.
sandbox: record every request from fresh /demo through a deterministic 3–1 match end, reset, and demo exit; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The game works offline after the first successful visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; load /demo; seed an obsolete release cache; reinstall the service worker; assert the old cache is removed; set context offline; reload and assert game and sample banner

claim: The game measures at least 55 rendered frames per second at a four-times CPU slowdown on a 390 by 844 viewport.
sandbox: fresh Chromium page at 390 by 844; four-times CPU slowdown; sample 90 requestAnimationFrame intervals and assert median is at least 55 fps

claim: A paused match is available after reload.
sandbox: start /demo, pause by keyboard, reload, assert paused state, then resume
